description: This source file provides utility functions related to local heavy check processes, including environment configuration, concurrency locking, and process management for local checks in a build or testing system.

methods.name: isLocalCheckEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the local check feature is enabled based on environment variable 'OPENCLAW_LOCAL_CHECK'.

methods.name: hasFlag
methods.description: Determines if a specific flag or argument is present in the argument list.

methods.name: applyLocalTsgoPolicy
methods.description: Modifies arguments and environment for local 'tsgo' policies, setting environment variables and inserting flags.

methods.name: applyLocalOxlintPolicy
methods.description: Adjusts arguments and environment for local 'oxlint' policies by inserting specific flags.

methods.name: acquireLocalHeavyCheckLockSync
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a filesystem-based lock for local heavy check processes, with retries and timeout handling, including process and lock reclaim logic.

methods.name: resolveGitCommonDir
methods.description: Resolves and returns the common directory of a Git repository.
